title_en: Reconciliation, D&IM testing, governance and DR: four kinds of difference, k-anonymity, RPO/RTO, country isolation
how_to_read: sentences[].w = first..last word id inside this chapter; word k (0-based) of the sentence is first+k and `ar` is the spoken text (its space-separated tokens are those words); fr = [start_frame, end_frame] at 24 fps from the word map; impact = hook words (id=text); num = spoken numbers with data-contract fact ids; first_mention = glossary terms to chip (id=term); dup = same claim in another chapter. Anchor with {word, lead_frames} only. Visual candidates are ideas, never footage.

constraints.anchors: {word, lead_frames} only; never seconds or frames; event frame = word start - lead_frames
constraints.lead_frames: kinetic word -3, graphic state change -2, shot cut -4..-6 (inside a pause >= 200 ms), counter starts at the number word
constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)
constraints.coverage: every sentence >= 1 anchored event; >= 80 % of sentences a mechanism event; every spoken number and every first-mention term on screen
constraints.kinetic: 8-20 kinetic words per minute; <= 6 words and <= 2 lines on screen; impact word 1-2 words
constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero
constraints.text: text on busy backgrounds needs a plate or halo; sizes and safe areas: 04 sections 3.2 and 3.4
banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)
constraints.components: use only frozen components (harness/schemas/components/); requests go to corpus/specs/_component_requests.jsonl
constraints.chapter_rhythm: problem -> mental model -> progressive visual -> worked example -> prediction -> failure (crit) -> fix (ok) -> callback -> artifact (per chapter, not per sentence)

sentences.ar: أهلا بيكم في شرح تفصيلي للمصدر ده
sentences.en: Welcome to the detailed walkthrough of this source.

sentences.ar: دايما بنشوف الأرقام قدامنا على الشاشات وبناخدها كأنها حقيقة مطلقة
sentences.en: We always see the numbers on our screens and take them as absolute truth.

sentences.ar: بس يا ترى إيه اللي بيحصل في الكواليس
sentences.en: But what is actually happening behind the scenes?

sentences.ar: الرحلة بتاعتنا النهاردة في عالم الback -end governance
sentences.en: Today's journey is in the world of back-end governance.

sentences.ar: هتكشف لنا إزاي المنصات الضخمة بتبني الثقة دي
sentences.en: It will reveal how huge platforms build this trust.

sentences.ar: هنتكلم عن الreconciliation واختبارات الD&IM والgovernance وطبعا إزاي بنعمل disaster recovery حقيقي
sentences.en: We will talk about reconciliation, the D&IM tests and governance, and how real disaster recovery is done.

sentences.ar: خلونا ندخل في التفاصيل ونشوف المعمارية دي بتتبني إزاي
sentences.en: Let's get into the details and see how this architecture is built.

sentences.ar: أجندة النهاردة سريعة ومتقسمة الخمس نقاط
sentences.en: Today's agenda is quick, split into five points.

sentences.ar: هنبدأ بأسطورة الnet total وبعدين الـ 5 phases والـ T1 to T4 matrix
sentences.en: We start with the net total myth, then the 5 phases and the T1 to T4 matrix.

sentences.ar: بعدها هندخل على الـ NRT tests والـ Data Privacy ثم الـ Security والـ Disaster Recovery
sentences.en: Next the NRT tests and data privacy, then security and disaster recovery.

sentences.ar: ونختم بالـ Scale والـ Final Verdict
sentences.en: We close with scale and the final verdict.

sentences.ar: يلا بينا؟ القسم الأول
sentences.en: Shall we go? Section one.

sentences.ar: الاختبار المعمالي ده لازم يغطي سيناريوهين أساسيين
sentences.en: This test must cover two basic scenarios.

sentences.ar: ال 1VS2 يعني بنقارن السورس بالبلاتفورم
sentences.en: 1VS2 means comparing the source with the platform.

sentences.ar: وال 2VS3 يعني بنقارن البلاتفورم بالوجهة النهائية أو ال report destination
sentences.en: And 2VS3 means comparing the platform with the final destination, the report destination.

sentences.ar: المطابقة هنا مستحيل تكون مجرد رقم نهائي
sentences.en: The matching here cannot be just a single final number.

sentences.ar: وهنا بيجي سؤال التوقع المهم جداً
sentences.en: Here comes the very important prediction question.

sentences.ar: لو قررنا نستسهل وقارننا الإجمالي بس يا ترى هنشوف إيه
sentences.en: If we decide to take the easy way and compare only the total, what will we see?

sentences.ar: السؤال ده بيفرض نفسه وقت تصميم أي نظام
sentences.en: This question imposes itself when designing any system.

sentences.ar: خلونا نفكر ثانية في النتيجة المحتملة للموضوع ده قبل ما نكشف الإجابة
sentences.en: Let's think for a second about the likely result before we reveal the answer.

sentences.ar: النتيجة ممكن تطلع ببساطة زائد 66 يورو رقم صغير جدا وشبه مقبول العين صح؟
sentences.en: The result may simply come out as plus 66 euro, a very small, almost acceptable number, right?

sentences.ar: بس الحقيقة إن الnet total ده بيكدب
sentences.en: But the truth is that this net total lies.

sentences.ar: الاعتماد عليه ممكن يكون مخبي وراء 3 أو 4 أعطال كوارثية
sentences.en: Relying on it may be hiding behind 3 or 4 catastrophic failures.

sentences.ar: ملهاش أي علاقة بعض بس بيلغوا بعض في الحسبة النهائية
sentences.en: They have no relation to each other, but they cancel each other out in the final tally.

sentences.ar: Reconciliation الحقيقي بقى بيفرز الفرق دي في طوابير واضحة
sentences.en: Real reconciliation sorts these differences into clear queues.

sentences.ar: بس لو ركزنا على طابور الtransposition هنلاقي فرق سالب 36
sentences.en: But if we focus on the transposition queue we find a difference of minus 36.

sentences.ar: وبعد كده كل حاجة بتروح لطابورها الخاص
sentences.en: After that everything goes to its own queue.

sentences.ar: القسم الثاني The Five Phases
sentences.en: Section two, the five phases.

sentences.ar: ومصفوفة T1 -T4 عشان نبني الثقة دي بشكل منهجي
sentences.en: And the T1-T4 matrix, to build this trust methodically.

sentences.ar: مراحل الـ Acceptance Testing بتتم على خمس خطوات صارمة
sentences.en: The Acceptance Testing phases happen in five strict steps.

sentences.ar: البداية مع الـ Huawei Functional Test لاختبار الصوفت وير من الأول للآخر
sentences.en: It starts with the Huawei Functional Test, testing the software end to end.

sentences.ar: بعدين بنطلع للـ SIT عشان نتأكد من التكامل مع الأطراف الثالثة
sentences.en: Then we go up to SIT to confirm integration with third parties.

sentences.ar: الخطوة الثالثة هي OAT لضمان متطلبات المجموعة ككل
sentences.en: The third step is OAT, to ensure the requirements of the group as a whole.

sentences.ar: والربعة هي الCAT الخاصة بمتطلبات كل دولة لوحدها
sentences.en: The fourth is the CAT, covering each country's own requirements.

sentences.ar: وأخيراً الperformance test لاختبار الساعة تحت الضغط
sentences.en: And finally the performance test, testing under pressure.

sentences.ar: ولو بصين على مصفوفة T1 لT4 دي بتعتبر القلب النابض لاختبارات الديتا
sentences.en: Looking at the T1 to T4 matrix, it is the beating heart of the data tests.

sentences.ar: T1 خاص بالintegration ولازم الفروق في الصفوف تكون صفر ودي أول خطوة دايماً
sentences.en: T1 is about integration and row differences must be zero, always the first step.

sentences.ar: بعد كده T2 للtechnical validation عشان نتأكد ان الpartitions القديمة بتتمسح في معادها
sentences.en: Then T2 for technical validation, to confirm old partitions are deleted on time.

sentences.ar: T3 بيقارن البيانات بمنطق SQL عشان نضمن الintegrity
sentences.en: T3 compares the data using SQL logic to guarantee integrity.

sentences.ar: وفي النهاية T4 بيضمن ان الفورمات اللي طالع من الweb portal مطابق تماماً للLLD مفيش ثغرة بتعدي
sentences.en: Finally T4 ensures the format coming out of the web portal matches the LLD exactly; no gap slips through.

sentences.ar: القسم الثالث اختبارات الNRT والdata privacy

sentences.ar: لما نتعامل مع البيانات اللحظية أو الnear real time الشروط بتكون معقدة
sentences.en: When dealing with real-time, near real time data, the conditions are complex.

sentences.ar: الKafka in out accuracy والRedis cache accuracy اللي اتنين متصنفين Critical

sentences.ar: والنتيجة المتوقعة ليهم هي الصفر mismatches
sentences.en: The expected result for them is zero mismatches.

sentences.ar: الصفر هنا مش طموح ضرورة أساسية عشان النظام يشتغل أصلا

sentences.ar: وأخيرا الretention الأوتوماتيكي لازم يمسح الداتا اللي بتخرج برى الوقت المحدد بشكل سليم

sentences.ar: نيجي لنقطة حماية الخصوصية والk-anonymity
sentences.en: We come to the point of privacy protection and k-anonymity.

sentences.ar: تخيلوا جدول من 9 صفوف
sentences.en: Imagine a table of 9 rows.

sentences.ar: لو شلنا منه المعرفات المباشرة زي الأسماء الخطر لسه موجود

sentences.ar: حتى لو عملنا generalization للبلد بردو K ممكن تفضل واحد

sentences.ar: القسم الرابع الأمان هنا مش مجرد سوفتوير بنصطبه
sentences.en: Section four: security here is not just software we install.

sentences.ar: الـsecurity والـdisaster recovery drill
sentences.en: Section four heading: security and disaster recovery drill.

sentences.ar: دي طبقات Defense in Depth مبنية في أساس المعمارية
sentences.en: These are Defense in Depth layers built into the foundation of the architecture.

sentences.ar: الشبكة معزولة تماماً ومفيش إنترنت مباشر

sentences.ar: نقل البيانات محمي بmTLS وTLS 1 .2
sentences.en: Data transmission is protected with mTLS and TLS 1.2.

sentences.ar: الصلاحيات محكومة بRBAC صارم جداً
sentences.en: Permissions are governed by very strict RBAC.

sentences.ar: والبيانات نفسها متشفرة بAES 256
sentences.en: And the data itself is encrypted with AES 256.

sentences.ar: والأهم إن التوافق مع قوانين زي الGDPR والAML مدعوم بImmutable Logs
sentences.en: Most importantly, compliance with laws like GDPR and AML is backed by immutable logs.

sentences.ar: يعني سجلات audit مستحيل تتمسح أو تتعدل

sentences.ar: وساعة الإيقاف بتبدأ تعد فوراً عشان نحسب وقت التحويل اليدوي للموقع الاحتياطي

sentences.ar: اللحظة دي هي اللي بتختبر كل التخطيط الهندسي
sentences.en: That moment is what tests all the engineering planning.

sentences.ar: وبتنقله من مجرد نظريات على الورق لواقع عمل قاسي تحت الضغط
sentences.en: It moves it from mere theory on paper to a harsh working reality under pressure.

sentences.ar: الساعة شغالة واللي بيحكمنا هنا هو ال -RPO أو Recovery Point Objective

sentences.en: These are the limits that guarantee the disaster does not destroy the platform's accuracy.

sentences.ar: وهنا بيظهر المقياس الثاني ال -RTO أو Recovery Time Objective

sentences.ar: يعني أقصى توقف مسموح بي هو ساعة واحدة بس

sentences.ar: وأول ما النظام يقوم بالسلامة بيتم فرض reconciliation إجباري عشان نتأكد إن ما فيش سجل واحد ضاع في النص
sentences.en: And as soon as the system is safely back, a mandatory reconciliation is enforced to confirm not a single record was lost midway.

sentences.ar: القسم الخامس والأخير على مستوى الحجم ده

sentences.ar: الtenant isolation بيبقى حارك جداً
sentences.en: Tenant isolation becomes very critical.

sentences.ar: الرد ما بيكونش مجرد error عادي لكن request rejected at the boundary

sentences.ar: عزل البيانات ده بيتم اختباره بدقة عشان نضمن السيادة الكاملة
sentences.en: This data isolation is tested precisely to guarantee full sovereignty.

sentences.ar: وما فيش أي استعلام بيقدر يخترق الحدود دي أبداً

sentences.ar: الأرقام هنا بتوضح حجم التحدي
sentences.en: The numbers here show the scale of the challenge.

sentences.ar: الـ NFRs بتفرض 99 .99 % Reliability

sentences.ar: الاختبارات دي كلها معمولة مخصوصة عشان تثبت إن المنصة قادرة تتحمل الحجم المهول ده من غير أي مشاكل

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.
glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

concepts.def_en: After loading, comparing source and target counts and totals to prove nothing was lost, duplicated or changed; any mismatch is investigated.
concepts.failure: Assuming a green job run means every row arrived, without comparing counts and totals.

concepts.def_en: The plan, backups and procedures for restoring systems and data after a major failure, within targets for acceptable data loss (RPO) and downtime (RT…
concepts.failure: Having backups but never testing a restore, so recovery fails when needed.

concepts.def_en: Near-real-time: data appears in reports within minutes of the event, faster than a daily batch but not instantaneous.
concepts.failure: Not measuring end-to-end lag, so 'near' real-time silently drifts into hours.

concepts.def_en: A data-entry error where two adjacent digits are swapped; the difference between the wrong and right amount is always divisible by 9.
concepts.failure: Hunting a missing record when the real cause is two digits swapped.

concepts.def_en: Checking that a delivered system meets the agreed business requirements, with every checklist item tied to evidence rather than the word 'passed'.
concepts.failure: Marking items passed without attaching evidence, so nobody can audit what was actually tested.

concepts.def_en: An automated check that runs code and asserts the expected result, so changes that break behaviour are caught early.
concepts.failure: Tests that never fail prove nothing; first watch the test fail, then fix.

concepts.def_en: Structured Query Language: the standard declarative language for querying and changing data in relational databases by describing what you want.
concepts.failure: Thinking SQL runs in written order; the engine plans execution in its own order.

concepts.def_en: A distributed, append-only event log: producers write events to topics, consumers read forward, and events are retained for a set window.
concepts.failure: Treating Kafka as a database with a different name; it is a log with retention.

concepts.def_en: Comma-separated values: a plain-text format of flat rows and columns, simple and universal but with no types or nesting.
concepts.failure: Assuming CSV preserves data types, so IDs lose leading zeros and dates become text.

concepts.def_en: A text format for nested key-value and list data, the common language of APIs.
concepts.failure: Assuming JSON keeps Python types like tuples or dates after a round trip.

concepts.def_en: A number measuring how wrong a model's prediction is; training adjusts weights to make it smaller.
concepts.failure: Judging a model by training loss alone; it keeps falling while test error rises.

concepts.def_en: A privacy guarantee that every record is indistinguishable from at least k-1 others on its quasi-identifying fields, so no one is unique.
concepts.failure: Hiding direct identifiers only; unique combinations of other fields still reveal individuals.

concepts.def_en: Transport Layer Security: a handshake that proves the server's identity and encrypts data in transit between client and server.
concepts.failure: Skipping certificate verification, which leaves traffic encrypted but possibly sent to an impostor.

concepts.def_en: Role-Based Access Control: permissions are granted to roles and users receive roles, following the rule of least privilege.
concepts.failure: Granting broad roles for convenience, giving users far more access than the job needs.

concepts.def_en: Recovery Point Objective: the maximum amount of data, measured as time, a business accepts losing in a disaster.
concepts.failure: Mixing up RPO and RTO: RPO is data loss tolerated, RTO is downtime tolerated.

concepts.def_en: Recovery Time Objective: the maximum downtime a business accepts before service is restored after a disaster.
concepts.failure: Promising an RTO that no recovery drill has ever tested.

concepts.def_en: A message or failure signalling that something went wrong; read it first, since it usually names the cause and the location.
concepts.failure: Pasting the error into a search engine without first reading the terminal output.

concepts.def_en: An open-source framework that stores huge data across many machines with HDFS and processes it in parallel, originally with MapReduce.
concepts.failure: Using Hadoop for small data; its overhead only pays off at large scale.

components.does: One whole word (or a tatweel-joined compound like الـKafka) on screen; never split per letter.
Up to 6 kinetic words on at most 2 lines, each word arriving on its own spoken word anchor.
A technical term chip (Latin in an LTR isolate) with an optional Arabic gloss; 28 px floor if spoken.
A counter that rolls from the previous value to the target over the spoken number (preset count).
An arrow from a label to a target layer (or a named part of it, 'layer.part').
Failure beat: glitch + low thud; flashes stay <= 3/s (WCAG 2.3.1).
Fix beat: the target settles into place with a settle chime.
The shot camera: move + ease + intensity; drift always on; optional impact nudges (<= 4 px) on anchors.
Match cut between a layer of this shot and one of the next.
